newsitem.title: USA: US wkly power output rises 2.0 pct vs year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: US wkly power output rises 2.0 pct vs year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 59,063 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended October 12, up two percent from the same period in 1995, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said Wednesday.
The amount of power supplied to the Rocky Mountain region rose the most from a year ago, up 11.5 percent to 3,239 GWh, EEI said in its weekly survey.
The latest week's power output was down 0.8 percent from previous week's 59,531 GWh.
Year-to-date domestic power production totaled about 2.63 million GWh, up 2.2 percent from the same 1995 period, EEI said.
